expectations.text: Describes the SEC's May 19, 2026 proposal, which would limit 404(b) auditor attestation to large accelerated filers and raise the large accelerated filer threshold
expectations.evidence: "On May 19, 2026, the SEC proposed to raise the large accelerated filer threshold to $2B float, exempt all non-accelerated filers from 404(b), and add a roughly 5-year post-IPO on-ramp."

expectations.text: States comments closed July 20, 2026 and there has been NO final action as of November 2026
expectations.evidence: "Comments closed July 20, 2026. As of November 6, 2026 there is no final action."

expectations.text: Concludes current 404(b) thresholds remain operative law, so preparation should not pause
expectations.evidence: "Short answer: do not pause. The exemption is only a proposal. It is not law." plus "The current rules govern."

expectations.text: Frames the proposal as proposed only, to be flagged and monitored
expectations.evidence: "A proposal can be changed, delayed or withdrawn... Nothing in it applies to your fiscal 2026 year-end" and advice to plan cost reduction "only if the rule is finalized."

expectations.text: Notes management's 404(a) assessment obligation is unaffected either way
expectations.evidence: "Even if the proposal is adopted, 404(a) stays. Management must still assess and conclude on ICFR."
